editorial: While fluid dynamics is pushing theoretical boundaries in technical literature today, compact language models are emerging in the open-source world with new versions focused on efficiency. GitHub and Hacker News data show that the search for technical depth continues across a wide spectrum, ranging from practical challenges in hardware engineering to complex mathematical problems.

items.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
items.summary: i-have-adhd is a Python library optimized for users with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) that simplifies complex and long responses from software development agents to facilitate focus. This tool aims to reduce information overload by turning technical outputs generated by agents into shorter and more direct responses.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: Diagram-design offers 38 different editorial diagram templates specifically prepared for AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi). These HTML and SVG-based designs, stripped of shadow effects to reduce visual clutter, provide an alternative visualization method to standard diagramming tools.

items.title: openai/skills
items.summary: Skills, shared by OpenAI, is a library of functional capabilities defined for the code-writing model Codex. It provides a structure that allows developers to equip AI models with the ability to perform specific tasks.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: ECC is a performance management system that optimizes capability, memory, and security layers for AI agents. It aims to increase the operational efficiency of systems such as the code editor Cursor and AI-powered coding platforms (Claude Code, Codex).

items.title: heygen-com/hyperframes
items.summary: Hyperframes, developed by Heygen, is a library that converts HTML code directly into video. It makes it easier for software developers to produce dynamic and visual content for AI agents.

items.title: coreyhaines31/marketingskills
items.summary: Marketingskills offers specialized skill packages for Claude Code and AI agents in areas such as conversion rate optimization, copywriting, search engine optimization (SEO), and data analytics. This JavaScript-based library provides ready-made workflows for developers looking to automate digital marketing processes.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Superpowers offers an agentic skills framework and software development methodology for AI agents. This tool allows developers to standardize their workflows when building agent-based systems.

items.title: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
items.summary: Based on Andrej Karpathy's observations regarding coding errors in large language models (LLM), this project provides a structured instruction file to improve the performance of the AI-powered coding tool Claude Code. By using this file, developers enable the AI to reduce common errors in code-writing processes and produce more consistent results.

items.title: microsoft/markitdown
items.summary: MarkItDown, developed by Microsoft, is a Python tool that converts various file formats and office documents into Markdown format. The software accelerates data preparation processes by converting complex file structures into a text-based format that AI models can easily process.

items.title: jo-inc/camofox-browser
items.summary: Camofox is a stealth browser (headless browser) that allows AI agents to bypass bot detection and web scraping blocks. It works compatibly with automation libraries like Puppeteer and Playwright to disable protection systems such as Cloudflare.

items.title: MoonTechLab/LunaTV
items.summary: Developed with the TypeScript language, LunaTV is an open-source media player that allows users to watch television broadcasts over the internet. The project provides an interface that facilitates user access to digital content.

items.title: browser-use/browser-use
items.summary: The Python-based browser-use library enables AI agents to use web browsers just like humans. This tool is designed to automate complex tasks such as navigating web pages and interacting with them.

items.title: mksglu/context-mode
items.summary: Context-mode is a tool that provides context window optimization for AI coding agents. It reduces data size by 98 percent by isolating tool outputs, preserves session memory, and routes across 17 different platforms via the Model Context Protocol.

items.title: The-Swarm-Corporation/AutoHedge
items.summary: AutoHedge is an investment tool that uses swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution processes. It allows users to create their own autonomous hedge funds in minutes.

items.title: liquidslr/system-design-notes
items.summary: Notes compiled from the book 'System Design Interview - An Insider's Guide' offer a comprehensive resource for understanding complex software architectures. It explains scalable system design processes and fundamental engineering principles with practical examples.

items.title: viarotel-org/escrcpy
items.summary: Escrcpy is a tool that allows viewing and controlling Android devices from a computer via a graphical interface. It provides a visual interface for the open-source scrcpy software, which mirrors the Android screen to the computer.

items.title: openai/plugins
items.summary: Plugins offered by OpenAI enable AI models to access real-time data and interact with external services. This structure allows language models to reach up-to-date information and perform actions in third-party applications on behalf of the user.

items.title: Navier-Stokes – Tristan Buckmaster [pdf]
items.summary: Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster offers a new solution approach for the Navier-Stokes equations, which form the basis of fluid dynamics. This work provides a theoretical contribution to solving complex differential equations used in predicting the behavior of physical systems.

items.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
items.summary: OpenAI has shared a mathematical solution proposal for the Navier-Stokes equations, which form the basis of fluid dynamics. The solution to these complex physical equations, which are among the Millennium Prize Problems, represents a critical stage in modeling turbulent flows.

items.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: a high-resolution map of human DNA
items.summary: AlphaGenome Atlas, developed by Google DeepMind, is a high-resolution mapping tool that predicts the effects of variants in the human genome. This model provides AI-powered predictions to understand the biological consequences of genetic mutations.

items.title: I resigned from Anthropic today
items.summary: The resignation of an engineer from the AI research company Anthropic has triggered discussions in the sector regarding safety-focused development processes and corporate governance practices. This departure has brought transparency expectations regarding the internal operations of organizations developing large language models back to the agenda.

items.title: We built our house for LAN parties (2024)
items.summary: Technology enthusiasts have built a residence specifically designed and optimized for LAN parties. This project embodies the concept of a gaming-focused living space with high-speed network infrastructure and physical space arrangements suitable for multiplayer setups.

items.title: XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B
items.summary: Spark-X2.5-4B, published on HuggingFace, is a compact language model focused on text generation. Aiming to provide fast responses with a low parameter count, this model provides developers with a resource-efficient AI solution.

items.title: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B
items.summary: MiniCPM5-2B, developed by OpenBMB, is a text-generation model that aims to offer high performance with low hardware resources. Despite its small size, this AI model, which can perform complex tasks, is specifically optimized to run on edge devices.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Qwen2.5-VL, developed by Alibaba, is a multimodal AI model capable of processing visual and text data. By analyzing complex images to generate text-based responses, this model appeals to a wide user base on the open-source AI platform Hugging Face.

items.title: ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-GGUF
items.summary: Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-GGUF, developed by ISTA-DASLab, is an AI model that processes visual and text data to produce text output. The model facilitates operation on local hardware by using quantization techniques, which are methods for compressing high-performance language models.

items.title: google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch
items.summary: TimesFM 3.0, developed by Google, is a large foundation model trained for time-series forecasting tasks. By learning complex patterns in datasets, it provides high-accuracy future predictions for time-dependent data across different sectors.

items.title: Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation
items.summary: Marigold V2 restructures widely used image generation models to solve the sharpness and generalization issues of models performing monocular depth estimation from a single image. Leveraging the diffusion transformers architecture, this method enables the acquisition of more detailed depth maps in fields such as robotics and scene generation.

items.title: RelightFormer: Feed-forward Generative Transformer for Multiview Object Relighting
items.summary: RelightFormer is a generative Transformer model that performs object relighting directly without complex inverse rendering processes. Adapted from video foundation models, this structure adjusts lighting while preserving 3D geometry in single or multi-image data.

items.title: Harnessing CLIP and DINO: An Uncertainty-Aware Cascaded Fusion Network for Generalizable Deepfake Image Detection
items.summary: UCF-Net is a network structure that combines vision foundation models like CLIP and DINO to detect fake images generated by AI. This uncertainty-aware method aims to offer higher accuracy against different types of fake content by preventing the model from overfitting to specific datasets.

items.title: Encoded Early, Used Late: Where Transformers Begin to Act on an Inferred Partner's Expertise
items.summary: It has been determined that transformer models encode inferential information, such as the expertise level of the other party in a dialogue, in their internal representation layers before reflecting this data in the output. This finding shows that there is a time gap between the process of AI models processing information and the stage of using it.

items.title: Cadence: Error-Bounded Lossy Compression of Demand Time Series with a Time-Series Foundation Model
items.summary: Cadence combines TimesFM-3, a time-series foundation model developed by Google, with an adaptive arithmetic encoder to compress numerical data within error margin limits. This method uses prediction accuracy to shrink datasets in a lossy manner, providing higher compression efficiency than traditional linear predictors.

items.title: How to build a f**king printer
items.summary: The guide prepared by Nishant Joshi explains step-by-step the process of developing a printer from scratch using hardware design and software integration. The project demonstrates how to assemble basic mechanical components and how to write the driver software required for the device to convert digital commands into physical prints.

items.title: What makes $BigTechCompany's products bad, anyway?
items.summary: The decline in user experience in products offered by large technology companies is explained by the increasing complexity of software and commercial goals taking precedence over user needs. This situation causes products to lose their functionality and makes it difficult to meet the basic expectations of users.

items.title: Switching Password Managers in 2026
items.summary: The process of securely exporting data and migrating it to a new system when switching between password managers presents technical challenges for users. In particular, the compatibility of data formats and the preservation of security protocols are among the key elements that users switching between password management tools need to pay attention to.

glossary.explanation: A neurological condition that affects the way the brain manages focus, impulse control, and movement.
The sum of knowledge, practice, and skills required to perform a task.
Intelligent software capable of using tools to make decisions on its own and achieve goals.
Adjustments made to websites to help them rank higher in search engines.
A structural framework that defines the capabilities artificial intelligence needs to perform complex tasks.
Advanced language models trained on massive amounts of text data capable of generating human-like responses.
A simple markup language that allows you to format your writing using only plain text characters.
A browser without a visual interface that can load and process web pages in the background.
Techniques that allow artificial intelligence to use the amount of information it can remember at once more efficiently.
A connection method that enables artificial intelligence models to communicate with different data sources in a secure and standardized way.
The phenomenon where many small units come together to act like a collective intelligence without being managed from a single center.
A software-based fund that analyzes market data and makes investment decisions on its own without human intervention.
The process of planning how the parts of a software will communicate with each other and how they will function.
Small utility software used to add new features to the main program.
Mathematical formulas used to calculate how variables change in relation to each other.
Artificial intelligence models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
